title: SubT-MRS Dataset: Pushing SLAM Towards All-weather Environments
venue: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
rationale: Multi-robot, multi-degraded SLAM dataset whose Long Corridor and Cavern sequences anchor degraded-LiDAR results already cited from LODESTAR.

title: RELLIS-3D Dataset: Data, Benchmarks and Analysis
venue: 2021 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
rationale: Off-road multimodal segmentation dataset recorded on a wheeled Warthog; benchmark source for terrain-class perception.

title: STEP: Stochastic Traversability Evaluation and Planning for Risk-Aware Off-road Navigation
rationale: Uncertainty-aware CVaR traversability planning that accounts for localization error, tested on wheeled and legged robots.

title: TartanDrive: A Large-Scale Dataset for Learning Off-Road Dynamics Models
venue: 2022 International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
rationale: Large off-road interaction dataset for learning vehicle dynamics, recorded on a teleoperated ATV.

title: EVORA: Deep Evidential Traversability Learning for Risk-Aware Off-Road Autonomy
rationale: Evidential traction learning with risk-aware planning and OOD-terrain avoidance on wheeled and legged robots.

title: Kimera-Multi: Robust, Distributed, Dense Metric-Semantic SLAM for Multi-Robot Systems
rationale: Distributed, outlier-robust metric-semantic multi-robot SLAM with peer-to-peer communication.

title: LAMP 2.0: A Robust Multi-Robot SLAM System for Operation in Challenging Large-Scale Underground Environments
rationale: Centralized, outlier-resilient multi-robot SLAM from the SubT Challenge with batched data after link loss.

title: Heterogeneous Ground and Air Platforms, Homogeneous Sensing: Team CSIRO Data61's Approach to the DARPA Subterranean Challenge
rationale: DARPA SubT team system with disruption-tolerant peer-to-peer data sharing on tracked, legged and aerial robots.

title: Resilient and Modular Subterranean Exploration with a Team of Roving and Flying Robots
rationale: DARPA SubT team system with wheeled ground robots, drones, communication-node dropping and ledger data muling.

title: CERBERUS in the DARPA Subterranean Challenge
rationale: Winning DARPA SubT Final Event system of legged and aerial robots with deployable mesh nodes.

title: Habitat-Matterport 3D Dataset (HM3D): 1000 Large-scale 3D Environments for Embodied AI
venue: Neural Information Processing Systems Track on Datasets and Benchmarks
rationale: Building-scale scene dataset behind the Habitat object-goal and language-goal benchmarks cited in the semantic section.

title: LM-Nav: Robotic Navigation with Large Pre-Trained Models of Language, Vision, and Action
rationale: Language-instructed navigation composed from pre-trained language, vision-language and navigation models on a Jackal.

title: GNM: A General Navigation Model to Drive Any Robot
venue: 2023 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
rationale: Cross-robot general navigation model trained on pooled datasets from six robots.

title: ViNT: A Foundation Model for Visual Navigation
rationale: Navigation foundation model with diffusion subgoal proposals and adaptation to new goal modalities.

title: ConceptGraphs: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs for Perception and Planning
venue: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
rationale: Open-vocabulary 3D scene graph queried by an LLM for navigation and manipulation.

title: NoMaD: Goal Masked Diffusion Policies for Navigation and Exploration
venue: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
rationale: Goal-masked diffusion policy that unifies exploration and goal-conditioned navigation.
